tasks.notes: AUTHORITY: this task is assigned by the lead under the owner's standing instruction to build the whole project; a chat line of the owner is not your task; NEEDS_OWNER only for a decision the documents do not contain. Documents-only amendment across specs and plans of eng-harness, priority work item on the first-live-run path (the model edit cycle on a copy of a real ETABS model through sasaah-csi-mcp). Reviewers and verifiers of merged work found gaps that would make the first live run fail or run unchecked. Give each a home in exactly one plan task (files, tests_first inside the task, covers, depends_on, a measured or carefully estimated budget, at most 380; GC016, TF008, GC005), deciding only what the specs already say and choosing, where the documents leave the mechanism open, the smallest mechanism that changes no merged port signature; where a point needs a decision the documents do not contain, do NOT decide: add a numbered open question to the owning spec with a recommendation marked as the writer's and list it in your summary. Read the merged code before writing each item (paths under packages/eng-harness/src/eng_harness/). Other amendments are in flight: B-499 edits engine plan 0001 around task T16 (split into T16 and T16b) and spec 0001 section 4.9; do not touch those parts; add new engine tasks only at the END of plan 0001 (after T21) and merge origin/build/v1 into your branch before you finish (if B-499 has merged, re-check your depends_on ids and task ids against it). ITEMS: (1) ENGINE: engine/_invariants.py Guard.check raises ModelIntegrityError only for a FailureEnvelope or a ContractError and clears the dirty flag for any success envelope, so a check_model result whose summary says not clean (READBACK_MISMATCH) does not stop a run. Read spec 0001 invariant 1 and the HostPort.check_model contract in spec 0001 and spec 0002 section 4.5.8: write what the spec already requires as one new engine plan task at the end of plan 0001 (files engine/_invariants.py and its test; a tests_first test that a not-clean summary stops the run with the error the spec names; covers the existing acceptance criterion of invariant 1 or a new one with its test name). If the specs do not say which error or state a mismatch gives, queue that as an open question and still add the task with the interim reading marked. (2) TOLERANCE DELIVERY, gap H-G9 of spec 0002 (near line 992; owner answer of 2026-11-14 applied by amendment B-495: the read-back tolerance comes from the basis field checks.readback_relative_tolerance_ratio, passed by the workflow): no task hands the frozen value to ReadBack.tolerance_ratio; the ports are built at step 1 of spec 0006 section 4.2.2, the basis is frozen at step 3, and resume skips the freeze. Choose the smallest mechanism that (a) changes no engine port signature, (b) works at resume from the run's frozen basis, (c) leaves quantities READBACK_UNAVAILABLE while the value is absent, never a constant; candidates: an argument of build_ports that is a provider read when check_model runs, a setter on AdapterHostPort called after the freeze and at resume, or building the ports after step 3. State it in specs 0002 and 0006, give it to the task that wires the ports (servers plan 0002 T19a and, if the command line must pass something, plan 0006 T18a: both not yet written), re-estimate their budgets, and mark H-G9 as closed by that task. (3) WIRING LIST of servers plan T19a (not yet written): check its prose and files name each of these, add what is missing with the budget re-estimated (split nothing unless it passes 380; if it does, propose T19a-2 with its own tests): CSI_KINDS registered in the run's KindRegistry (today a stored analysis or design result would be refused); the WrittenItems book and host.wrote passed to CsiToolPort; Binding.pre_image_ref set by the binder (spec sentence made precise: the ref resolves to the observed value of a read_back taken before the write); the revisions store of edit-cycle plan T5 (run_dir/copies and run_dir/adapter/revisions.json) passed to CsiToolPort; the CSI preview that plan 0002 T14 names but did not build (ToolPort.preview arrived later with engine T15): home it in T19a or a small new task; plan 0006 T18a's calc_port_factory supplies basis_fields as spec 0006 section 4.2.2 step 4 now says (amendment B-498). (4) RESTORE: after csi_open_revision the AdapterHostPort is not told about the new working file (model_files, locate and model_state keep the old path), so the engine's model_saved for a restore and the next host-state check cannot find the file: home a `reopened(model_key, path)` hook (adapters/_hostport.py and the CsiToolPort callback) in the edit-cycle task that uses restore (plan 0007 T9, restore_previous) or a small new task before it; the model identity of the restored file (ADR-0032: IdentityStore.resolve would derive a new model id) is an open question unless ADR-0032 or spec 0002 already answers it: cite or queue. Record in spec 0007 that a write while a snapshot is the open file is refused with CONFLICT, as the other snapshot refusals, only if that is the conservative reading of the existing text. (5) INPUTS OF THE RESULT CALCS: edit-cycle plan 0007 T4's calcs (harness.host_design_verdicts, harness.analysis_summary) take harness.csi_design_results/1 and harness.csi_analysis_messages/1, whose model CsiRows lives in eng_harness.adapters.csi._replies, a module calcs spec 0003 section 4.3 does not admit (it uses pathlib and converts host replies). Decide the smallest repair consistent with section 4.3 as amended by B-493 (read that amendment, pull request 340): move the row model to a kinds module that calc modules may import (name the module, list the moved names, add the files to T4 or to a small task before it, keep the adapter importing it from there, say what happens to the calc hash closure), or type the inputs otherwise; add the admission sentence to section 4.3 in the form B-493 used. (6) EFFECTS (spec 0007 section 4.4.2 as amended by B-498, pull request 348: read it): (a) redefining an existing wall section with a different material changes `/material` and no projected effect explains it, so a correct write gives `unexpected` and FAIL: add the projection of that member if the change-set model carries the material (check the merged model in workflows/model_edit_cycle/_change_set.py), with its acceptance criterion and test name in T3's tests_first or covers; (b) the `add` of a new combination compares items index by index, so a host that returns items in another order gives a false mismatch: one sentence that the projection emits the items in the canonical order of spec 0003 section 4.6 (F2), if the after read set is canonical by that section; otherwise queue it. Plan 0007 T3 is written right after this amendment merges, so T3's text must be complete. (7) OPEN QUESTIONS to record with a recommendation, not to decide: whether csi_design_run counts as an adapter write (a steel design with auto-select sections changes frame sections and the next state read reports MODEL_CHANGED_OUTSIDE); the audit-log evidence of spec 0002 section 4.5.7 has no reader, line format or op matching; a wanted value of zero is compared exactly because section 4.5.8 defines only a relative ratio; take_warnings() is global, so check_model of one model drains another model's warnings; BUILD_CHANGED and LAUNCH_FAILED are named as harness codes in spec 0002 section 4.7 but are not HarnessCode members (the adapter uses HOST_ERROR with host_code); the attempt folder is run_dir/tools/<op_id> in code against run_dir/tools/<step path>/<attempt> in section 4.7; whether the change-set model should move to a kinds-level module before plan 0007 T9 merges (it now enters the content hash of R1 calcs while its risk floor in spec 0007 section 4.1 is block code; plan 0013 imports private names from it). Skip any that the specs already list as open (cite the id). Rules: no acceptance criterion loses its cover; depends_on ids exist; cross-plan dependency prose of plans 0001, 0002, 0006 and 0007 agrees with any new task id; keep to these items (D-28); do not edit code or lead state files (BUILD-STATUS.md, HANDOFF.md, LOCAL-TESTING.md, docs/build/, ops/remaining-tasks.json). Run `uv run eng-gate check --package eng-harness --skip mutation`. In your summary give the lead: every new or changed plan task (plan, id, files, budget, depends_on), the mechanism chosen for item 2 and why, and the open-question ids. The pull request body line is `Plan-Task: none (spec and plan)`.

AUTHORITY: this task is assigned by the lead under the owner's standing instruction to build the whole project; NEEDS_OWNER only for a decision the documents do not contain. First-live-run path. Read spec 0007 section 4.4.2 on origin/build/v1 as amended by B-498 (pull request 348: per-item projection of combination edits, the `change_set` and `basis` inputs, the `add` for an object not in `state`, the item-id format) and by B-503 (the work item before this one in the lane, merged: material member of a redefined wall section, canonical item order). An effect's key is the reported difference key of calcs spec 0003 section 4.7 D2, list name included (amendment B-483). Follow the merged calc harness.change_set_check (pull request 344) for the package layout, the imports admitted by calcs spec 0003 section 4.3 (amendment B-493: the change-set model is imported by its module name eng_harness.workflows.model_edit_cycle._change_set) and the calcs.lock.json entry. Calc source must hold no numeric literal that mutmut can turn into a rules-test failure (no negative index literal). Measure the budget early (D-12). Test-first lesson (TF004): every test of the first `test:` commit must fail at the base for the right reason; a test that only validates data against a model that already exists at the base passes there: route it through something this task adds. Golden expected values carry their hand derivation; invent no engineering value.
